title: Twice With the Hand
setup: November 2009, second leg of the World Cup qualifying play-off between France and Ireland. The match is 1-1 after extra time, which gives France a 2-1 aggregate win. In extra time Thierry Henry handles the ball twice before William Gallas knocks it over the line. Ireland asks FIFA for a replay.
question: What does FIFA decide?
options: Order a replay and ban Henry for two matches.
No replay and no punishment for Henry.
ruling: FIFA said the match cannot be replayed. Its Disciplinary Committee found no legal basis to act, stating that handling the ball cannot be regarded as a serious infringement under article 77a of its Disciplinary Code, so Henry was not punished. France went to the 2010 World Cup in South Africa and Ireland did not.
rulebookNote: The source notes that FIFA's rules make referee decisions final. It does not say what the referee saw.
